title: The decline drawn down, then taken back

members.role: a single value's decline drawn down
the line unwinds when the sentence leaves the chart (E50), on kinetics:stroke reversed
the page empties before handing over to a plate

does: The fall is drawn as a fall, and when the sentence leaves the chart the page gives it back: the line unwinds from where it stands and the sheet empties itself before the next thing mounts.
